supplementalBreakdowns.title: Iowa Judicial Branch FY2024 actual expenditures by class
supplementalBreakdowns.basis: Thirty-two nonzero FY2024 actual expenditure classes for budget unit 444B200001 total $205,368,894. The printed $205,591,946 disposition less $223,056 of reversions implies a $205,368,890 expenditure control, so the published whole-dollar leaves are $4 high; the source discrepancy is preserved without a balancing row. This core Judicial Branch operating-unit boundary is separate from and not additive to the broader Census Judicial and Legal function.

supplementalBreakdowns.title: CMS-64 federal Medicaid share by service · 4 rows
supplementalBreakdowns.basis: Final FY2024 CMS-64 rows total $6,299,983,944 for Iowa's federal Medicaid share. CMS does not publicly release category-of-service quarters, so any annual row still above $10B is an explicit public disclosure ceiling rather than an invented split. Medicaid is a major component of public welfare, but this federal-share boundary is supplemental—not additive—to the broader Census state-government function.
supplementalBreakdowns.sourceLabel: CMS MBES/CBES FY2024 Financial Management Report

parent: Direct Expenditure - General Expenditure - Total Public Welfare
supplementalBreakdowns.title: Iowa SFY2024 adjusted Medicaid MLR numerator by health plan and component
supplementalBreakdowns.basis: Independent accountants examined the adjusted SFY2024 medical-loss-ratio numerator for Iowa's three Iowa Health Link managed-care plans, with claims paid through December 31, 2024. The $7.885282613B numerator comprises incurred claims and qualifying health-care-quality activities; it is not complete Medicaid spending and is a separate, non-additive plan-accounting view of Census's $10.256584B total public-welfare function—including $10.191610B of current operations—and Iowa's $8.489113B all-funds Medicaid total.
supplementalBreakdowns.sourceLabel: Iowa HHS FY2024 Iowa Health Link MLR examinations
